title: Verification data and formal proofs for Bimodality of the elephant random walk

creators.name: Pemmasani, Arjun
creators.affiliation: Department of Mathematics, Harvey Mudd College

description: Certificate scripts and records, a Lean 4.33.1 formal library with pinned Mathlib revision, a complete declaration and axiom audit, and numerical illustration data for the Paper D EJP revision. The manuscript and MAP distinguish formal proofs from written proofs, classical inputs and Arb numerical checks.
